articleTitle: SSE-YOLO : A Lighter and Faster Object Detection Network for Small Targets in Sonar Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Due to the small size of the targets in sonar images, state-of-the-art target detection algorithms hardly make adaptable improvements to the sonar image. This paper proposes a lightweight target detection network, namely SSE-YOLO, to meet the premise of real-time fast detection of underwater targets under equipment computing power limitations. This improved model designs a lightweight feature extraction module SSE based on YOLOV3 to build a new lightweight backbone network. In order to enhance small target characterization, a new YOLO prediction layer is constructed by fusing more shallow features with deeper features. Moreover, the convolutional attention mechanism module CBAM is used in the neck network to improve the anti-background interference capability by strengthening the detection target features. In particular, a dataset of more than 17,000 sonar images containing three types of targets in a water tank experiment was built. Ultimately, compared with classic lightweight networks, the proposed network has the best performance in the dataset. Results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed network, achieving a satisfactory balance between performance and consumption, which satisfies the requirements of high accuracy, small model size, and real-time.

articleTitle: A Digital Twin Model Construction Method for Ships
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Digital twin technology can make the dynamic mapping of physical space and digital space, which can enable the transformation and upgrading of R&D, manufacturing and operation modes of industry and manufacturing. Applying digital twin technology to ship design and manufacturing can realize intelligent control and operation of ships. In this paper, a digital twin model construction for ships is proposed, including virtual scene generation system, digital twin sensor system, digital twin hull model, digital twin power system, digital twin security system and other functional models, which can support scheme generation, scheme pre-testing and task planning of navigation system and task system.

articleTitle: An Area Restriction Scheme Based on TAC Control Policy for 5G Private Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: With the rapid development of 5G technology, industry users in the process of accelerating to the digital intelligent transformation of the network coverage quality, delay, uplink capacity and stability and other performance has an urgent need. 5G private network has technical characteristics such as open network architecture, virtual intelligent orchestration of network elements, and air interface capabilities. It can provide a dedicated network with differential performance, autonomy and control, agility and security on the basis of meeting the requirements of network performance indicators. In this paper, we discuss an area restriction technology based on tracking area code (TAC) control policy for 5G private network. Based on the design of 5G private network architecture and TAC control policy, we focus on proposing the related 5G private network area restriction technology. This scheme can provide a unified data interaction channel for all kinds of wireless intelligent devices, and continuously integrate all kinds of sensing terminals with sensing and monitoring capabilities into all aspects of the industrial production process. Finally, a typical application scenario is presented to demonstrate the effectiveness and safety of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A MACA-Based Energy-Efficient MAC Protocol Using Q-Learning Technique for Underwater Acoustic Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: One of the major challenge in underwater acoustic wireless sensor networks (UWASNs) is designing the energy efficient medium access control (MAC) protocol. Because in UWASNs, all nodes are battery-operated and replacing these batteries every time is a crucial problem in UWASNs. Various challenges such as, high error rate, long propagation latency and low bandwidth also affect the designing of MAC protocols in UWASNs. In this research, a MACA-based energy-efficient MAC protocol using the Q-learning technique is proposed for UWASNs. Our opted protocol decreases collisions while retaining better energy efficiency. The ability of the sensor Rx nodes to avoid collisions in the absence of any previous interference knowledge, which eliminates the requirement for further indicating, is a crucial component of the suggested technique. Compared to other MAC protocols, simulation results demonstrate that our opted MAC protocol performs significantly better in terms of throughput, end-to-end delay, and energy consumption.

articleTitle: A Visible Light Geometric Multilateration Based Positioning System to Localize Nodes in an UWSNs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: While establishing up a wireless communication link between communicating nodes in a terrestrial scenario is straightforward, but doing so for underwater applications is actually quite difficult. As underwater communication has its own challenges that needs to be catered. After establishing successfully a communication link between nodes, comes the part of localization in underwater wireless sensor networks (UWSNs). Due to severe multipath and the inability of line of sight to be satisfied, it is exceedingly challenging to simulate the signal propagation in the complex underwater environment. Here in this study a geometric multilateration strategy based on received signal strength indication (RSSI) will be presented to localize nodes in UWSNs, using visible light communication (VLC). Where both the communicating nodes, i.e. anchor Tx nodes and sensor Rx nodes are considered perpendicular to each other.

articleTitle: The Control Characteristics of the Fin Stabilizer Servo System Based on Direct-Drive Volume Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The direct-drive volume control (DDVC) is applied to the control of ship fin stabilizers, which has the advantages of high efficiency, high reliability, small size and strong anti-pollution ability compared with the pump and valve control system used in traditional fin stabilizers. The article first briefly introduces the composition and principle of the DDVC system. The DDVC consists of an AC permanent magnet synchronous motor, a quantitative hydraulic pump, two hydraulic cylinders and fins. The AC servo motor rotates, driving the quantitative pump to rotate. Then, the oil is pushed to the two hydraulic cylinders, which drives the two hydraulic cylinders to swing back and forth. Lastly, the stable fins rotate. According to the system schematic diagram, the linearized mathematical model of the direct-drive fin stabilizer for simulation is summarized. Considering the uncertainty parameters and low servo bandwidth of the system, the QFT controller was designed to widen the system bandwidth and improve the dynamic characteristics. The designed servo system was placed in the entire fin system to verify the stability effect of the system under different sea conditions. The Simulink study shows that the device can work effectively.

articleTitle: Leak Detection of Underwater Pipelines Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Due to the complex marine environment, the leak detection of undersea natural gas pipelines is facing great difficulties. To solve the problem, this paper takes the bubble flow generated by the pipeline leakage as the detection object and uses the ultrasonic transmission method to conduct nondestructive detection. The wavelet threshold method is used to denoise the recorded signals, and the two bubble flow detection models based on the support vector regression (SVR) and BP neural network are proposed. The experimental results and the proposed evaluation indicators indicate that the support vector regression algorithm performs better, which is more suitable for the detection of underwater bubble flow. Therefore, the machine learning algorithm provides effective help for the development of submarine pipeline detection technology in a more efficient and accurate direction.

articleTitle: Research on Underwater Target Scale Recognition Method Based on Difference Characteristics of Dual Frequency Echo Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Underwater target classification and recognition are of great significance for underwater acoustic detection. It is one of the important technologies for underwater information acquisition and underwater information confrontation, and its emphasis is feature extraction. Aiming at underwater acoustic target echo signals, this paper applies a convolutional neural network to target recognition and establishes a scale recognition model combining echo signals of different frequency bands. The processing results of the actual experimental data show that the recognition rate of the dual-frequency echo signal is higher than that of the comparison method, which proves the effectiveness of dual-frequency joint processing in the application of underwater acoustic target recognition.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Sound Propagation In Horizontal Change Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: A numerically efficient three-dimensional (3D) model for waveguides with solitary internal waves is presented. The presented model is a forward-marching model that neglects backscattering. Since in general backscattering from internal waves is weak, the presented model is able to provide 3D field results with satisfactory accuracy. At the same time, it can achieve an efficiency gain of at least an order of magnitude over full two-way 3D models. Numerical simulations are also provided to validate the presented model, where a two-way, 3D model serves as the benchmark. Besides, a directional pattern is observed caused by the solitary internal wave. A detailed analysis of this angle-dependent interference pattern is also given in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Heading Control of Unmanned Surface Vehicle with Variable Parameter Full Format Model-Free Adaptive Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: A variable parameter model-free adaptive heading control method for USV was proposed to solve the uncertainty problem of external disturbances. Through theoretical analysis and experimental research, it is found that the heading control subsystem of USV is not self-balancing, and the direct use of standard full-format model-free adaptive control method will lead to oscillation of heading response and failure of convergence. By drawing history inputs into the standard control criteria, a variable parameter full-format model-free adaptive control method is proposed to decrease the integral function already present in the bow control subsystem of USV. Simulation tests verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Coal Adulteration Content Prediction Method Based on Improved PSO-SVR
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Coal is one of the most basic energy raw materials in China and gangue is the common way of adulterating thermal coal. Compared with other methods, the detection method of adulterated coal based on electrical impedance is more suitable for coal trading, which have many objects to be detected and require short detection times. However, the precision of current prediction algorithms for this technique is insufficient and the relative error is high. To tackle this problem, a prediction method based on improved particle swarm optimization algorithm optimizing the support vector regression algorithm (PSO-SVR) is proposed. This method can improve the convergence speed and convergence accuracy of PSO. Furthermore, the dataset was built by testing adulterated coal samples. The test results show that our prediction method performs better and the relative error in the predicted data is smaller.

articleTitle: Adaptive Step-Size Sparse Millimeter Wave Imaging Algorithm Based on Approximate Observations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The currently constructed millimeter wave imaging system has the problems of long sampling time and more sampling points of antenna units, and the use of compressed perception algorithm can improve the imaging quality when the number of sampling points are much smaller than the Nyquist distance sampling. The traditional compressed perception algorithm can achieve better sparse recovery than the matched filter imaging algorithm, but there is a large dimension of the measurement matrix and high computational complexity. For the problems of difficult data processing and large dimensions of measurement matrix, a sparse imaging regularization model is constructed based on approximate observation, and an improved soft threshold iterative algorithm is used with adaptive step size, which improves the convergence performance, reduces the computational complexity of the sparse recovery dramatically and achieves a better quality of sparse imaging than the traditional compressed perception algorithm.

articleTitle: A Path Tracking Algorithm Based on Model Predictive Control for Bionic Underwater Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The path tracking problem is a key technology basis for many military and civil applications of underwater vehicles. As for the bionic underwater vehicle mentioned in our paper, the path tracking task is much difficult. Aiming at the path tracking problem of bionic underwater vehicles, this paper introduces a new algorithm. Based on the linearized and discretized error model description, the model predictive control method was applied. The optimization problem is transformed into a quadratic programming problem with some constraints, and through further computing, the optimal solution is gained under the condition of satisfying the control constraints. The simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively control the path and reach the desired target.

articleTitle: A Dual-Queue Active Queue Management Scheme to Enhance Overall Performance of Data Flows
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Shorter latency improves performance of delay-sensitive Internet applications. However, for less stable networks such as WLAN, reducing target queuing delay or queue length in Active Queue Management (AQM) algorithms easily creates empty queues and lower throughput for bandwidth-intensive flows. Fortunately, bandwidth-intensive data flows are usually insensitive to latency, while delay-sensitive ones transmits less data. Therefore, the paper proposes a fairness-oriented AQM scheme, which administers different data flows using different queue management strategies. The scheme assigns data flows to queues managed by different AQM algorithms based on their respective bandwidth usage. Simulation results show that in unstable network environment, the proposed scheme decreases queuing delay for delay-sensitive data flows and shortens Average Flow Completion Time, when maintains high traffic throughput at the same time.

articleTitle: Research on Application Technology of Local Sound Field Virtual Control Technology in Ship Cabin Noise Reduction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In the process of controlling the environmental noise of ship cabins, low-frequency noise control is a technical difficulty. With the development of adaptive active noise reduction technology and the application of virtual sensing technology, virtual sensing technology can be applied to cabin noise reduction in the local sound field to achieve noise reduction in personnel operating positions or battle positions. This paper further studies the multi-channel virtual sensor noise reduction algorithm, and realizes the noise reduction in a larger area by designing an algorithm for multiple virtual error points. On the basis of the 8-input 4-output noise reduction model, 8 virtual channels are constructed, and the typical 20-800Hz environmental broadband noise is controlled. The test results show that noise reduction can be achieved at all 8 virtual points, and the noise reduction the volume reaches 7.9-10.3dB; in the simulated ship cabin, the space noise can also be reduced within the same range of 40cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sup>40cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sup>40cm.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Network-based Residual Self- interference Cancellation Method for In-band Full- duplex Underwater Acoustic Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In-band full-duplex underwater acoustic communication (IBFD-UWAC) provides a reliable solution to improve the utilization of the underwater spectrum. An effective self-interference cancellation (SIC) method leads to a better bit error rate (BER) performance. We propose a deep neural network-based residual self-interference cancellation (DNN-RSIC) method to handle residual self-interference after analog or spatial domain SIC. The estimated self-interference channel in the current environment is obtained by training the neural network so that the estimated self-interference signal can be deleted from the received signal to achieve SIC. We show the enhanced performance of the DNN-RSIC through simulations and experiments.

articleTitle: Global Path Planning of Unmanned Underwater Vehicle with Asexual Reproduction Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: A global path planning algorithm with asexual reproduction optimization (ARO) is proposed to solve the local optimum of path planning problem for unmanned underwater vehicles (UUVs). Firstly, the working spaces of UUV are modeled and encoded, and each path is represented by a chromosome. Secondly, in order to increase the diversity of paths, a reproduction operator suitable for path planning is put forward and a new bud path is generated by the reproduction operator from the parent path. Finally, a cost function is designed to evaluate the parent and bud paths, retaining the better path among the parent and bud paths. The proposed method is a global path planning algorithm with high convergence speed and high stability in complex working environments. The performance of global planning, convergence ability and stability in different working spaces are simulated and verified respectively. Simulation experiments verify the feasibility and reliability of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Compressed Sensing-Based Channel Estimation for OTFS in Continuous Delay-Doppler Domain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) modulation offers significant performance advantages over orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) in doubly dispersive channels. Estimating the delay-Doppler (DD) channel response of the receiver is necessary for OTFS signal detection. In this paper, we propose a two-stage channel estimation method. First, the Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP) algorithm is used for integer delay-Doppler coarse estimation, and then the Fibonacci Search method is employed to estimate the fractional delay and Doppler. Simulation results show that the proposed method outperforms other channel estimation methods in terms of normalized mean square estimation error (NMSE) performance. The estimation accuracy of a one percent DD resolution can be obtained through a small number of iterations.

articleTitle: Underwater Long Distance Wireless Optical Communication System With Large Divergence Angle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: This paper implements an underwater wireless optical communication real-time transmission system based on 520nm LED array and PMT reception with complete software and hardware implementation. The luminous power of the transmitter is 4.41 W with a divergence angle of 6 degrees and the receiver sensitivity is -55dBm. Through experiments in a test pool, the communication performance of the system has been verified to be as long as 188.9 m in pure water in communication distances and 5Mbps in communication rate and the BER less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup>. The relatively good result shows that a system adopting LED and PMT detection is promising for large-coverage and long-distance underwater optical communication.

articleTitle: Sound Power Measurement for Underwater Moving Sound Source Based on Gate-Shaped Sensor Array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of measuring the radiated sound power for underwater moving sound sources, a measurement method for their radiated noise based on gate sensor array is proposed. The beam forming measurement method based on scaled sound intensity can effectively measure the radiated sound power of static sound sources. For the case of moving sound sources, combined with the time domain beam forming method, which is usually used to remove the Doppler effect, the beam output results are scaled and integrated on the established virtual source surface to obtain the radiated sound power of the moving sound source. The numerical simulation results show that this method can effectively measure the radiated sound power of the underwater moving sound source and greatly improve the measurement accuracy of the radiated sound power of an underwater vehicle.

articleTitle: An Incremental Domain Adaptation Method for Object Detection of Unmanned Surface Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Visual object detection is expected to provide adequate environmental information for the unmanned surface vehicle (USV), but its performance usually drops due to the changeable marine scenarios, such as weather and light conditions. To address this problem, the most common way is domain adaptation, which can adapt the model trained for the source domain to the target domain. However, the existing domain adaptation approaches aim to improve the detection performance on the target domain while the performance on the source domain suffers from a significant decrease. To solve this catastrophic forgetting while adapting to a new domain, we proposed an incremental domain adaptation approach for object detection. Our method can be divided into two steps: firstly, we translate images from the source domain into images that match the data distribution of target domain images; secondly, an incremental learning method based on knowledge distillation is adopted to learn the generated images. Experiments on Singapore Maritime Dateset and our simulation dataset suggest that the proposed method can successfully adapt to new domains and prevent performance degradation in the previous domain. Consequently, our method can efficiently and timely adapt to various marine scenarios that the USV encounters to improve its robustness of environmental perception.

articleTitle: SOC Estimation Algorithm of EKF Marine Lithium-Ion Battery Based on SVM Noise Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In electric ships, the working conditions of ships are mainly divided into maneuvering working conditions and constant speed working conditions. The current of lithium-ion battery changes rapidly under maneuvering conditions, and it is stable under constant speed conditions. When the extended Kalman filter (EKF) algorithm is used to estimate the Stage of Charge (SOC) of lithium-ion battery, if the current situation suddenly changes, there will be current offset noise. In order to improve the accuracy of SOC estimation, Support Vector Machine (SVM) is used to identify ship working conditions, and then the noise matrix of maneuvering conditions is adjusted. The results show that the improved algorithm improves the accuracy of SOC estimation by about 0.5% under maneuvering conditions and about 1% under switching conditions, and the improved algorithm has better tracking effect on SOC.

articleTitle: Indoor Sparse NLOS Environment Localization Method Based on Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: High-precision location-based services (LBS) have become a crucial infrastructure for modern society, yet identifying and suppressing non-line-of-sight (NLOS) error is a significant factor that limits positioning accuracy. To tackle the challenge of achieving high-precision localization without prior information, this paper proposes an indoor NLOS environment localization method based on compressed sensing. Firstly, the location of the user equipment (UE) is estimated using an improved 2.5D Chan algorithm, and subsequently, a discrete transformation method with time-difference-of-arrival (TDOA) observations to sparse NLOS space is constructed based on the estimated locations. And using the reconstructed sparse NLOS error vector, the localization error can be further reduced by an iterative method with adaptive thresholding (IMAT). The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method displays higher accuracy and robustness compared to traditional NLOS mitigation algorithms.

articleTitle: Optimization of Sea-Rail Intermodal Operation Process Based on IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: This paper aims at the problems existing in the operation process of sea-rail intermodal operation, based on the Internet of Things (IoT) technology, the existing operation process is analyzed using the value chain theory to identify influencing factors and problems. Then, considering the characteristics of IoT technology and the sea-rail intermodal operation process, the sea-rail connection operation process is optimized to improve the efficiency of sea-rail intermodal operations and achieve the informatization management of container sea-rail intermodal logistics, enhancing its core competitiveness. Finally, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method and the method of with and without comparison are combined to scientifically verify the evaluation results of sea-rail intermodal transportation before and after the application of IoT technology, which are relatively poor and good respectively, quantitatively demonstrating the significant importance of IoT technology in improving the sea-rail intermodal operation process and its positive promoting effect on its development.

articleTitle: Design of an MPU9250-Based Attitude Data Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Attitude solving plays a crucial role in various fields, as it enables accurate determination of an object's orientation and helps optimize system performance. By providing precise attitude information, the MPU9250 nine-axis sensor contributes to the design of balance bikes, aerial mice, and other applications. The project utilizes the STM32F767 microcontroller to interface with the MPU9250 sensor, enabling the acquisition of raw data. The Digital Motion Processor (DMP) and Motion Process Library (MPL) library are employed to perform attitude solving, allowing for real-time estimation of the object's Euler angles. The results from the proposed method demonstrate accuracy, providing a reliable and cost-effective solution for precise attitude resolution. This research enhances operational efficiency, optimizes system performance, and reduces computational complexity. Future efforts will focus on mitigating errors arising from environmental factors.

articleTitle: Improved Sonar Target Detection Method Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Side-scan sonar target detection will soon be used in the field of detect sunken ships and various underwater targets, and has received an increasing attention of scientific researchers in recent years. However, many existing deep-CNNs side-scan sonar detectors still suffer from weaker small target detection performance. It may be attributed to the fact that the layers of a deep convolutional neural network are too deep, which leads to the loss of high frequency information. In this study, we propose a new framework to achieve the robust detection of small targets in side-scan sonar images. Firstly, considering that small targets require more high-frequency features, we propose a Spatial Pyramid Polling Fast++ (SPPF++) module and apply it to the backbone layer network to avoid the loss of feature information for sonar small targets. Secondly, we apply an attention module to the backbone network to improve the recognition ability of small targets. Finally, the Efficient Intersection over Union (EIoU) loss is applied to the regression branch, reducing the network's dependence on the target aspect ratio and improving the accuracy of the regression. Comparing with the state-of-arts detectors, our model has got the better performance. Experiments show that the accuracy of our model has greatly improved compared with YOLOv5-s, and the model parameters have only increased very little, which has practical significance for target detection in side-scan sonar images.

articleTitle: Design of Distributed Ultra-High-Definition Resolution Display System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: A practical and scalable ultra-high-definition resolution display system for multi-screen display wall is constructed based on multiple distributed low-definition display nodes, and the collaborative processing mechanism between distributed display nodes is the key to the performance of the display system. In order to improve the performance of image synchronization between distributed nodes, a node collaboration mechanism based on IEEE1588 time synchronization protocol and phase-locked loop is proposed. A synchronization processing system applied to ultra-high-definition resolution displays is designed, which not only shortens the image processing time but also improves the image synchronization processing performance. The system synchronization test results show that the maximum display frame difference between splicing display units is 0.47 frame and the average system delay is 98.67ms. The provided system can effectively shorten system data processing time, solve synchronization problems of ultra-high-definition resolution displays, meet requirements of large screen display images, and improve users' experience effect.

articleTitle: Improving Motor Imagery-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces with Chebyshev Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: This study aims to enhance the accuracy and generalization of motor imagery-based brain-computer interface (MI-BCI) systems using a novel frequency-based graph convolutional neural network technique called Chebyshev Graph Neural Networks (ChebGNNs). The study involves acquiring a substantial amount of motor imagery EEG signals and merging them with an open-source dataset to create a heterogeneous dataset. The study shows that ChebGNNs significantly improve the training and classification performance of the MI-BCI model. ChebGNNs outperform conventional frequency-based and time-domain techniques, achieving an average accuracy of 91.09%, 90.27%, and 89.24% on various datasets. The study demonstrates the promising potential of graph convolutional neural networks in improving the accuracy and generalization of MI-BCI systems. This enables a more effective capture of correlation information and local characteristics in signals, thereby enhancing the overall performance of the system.

articleTitle: Mechanical Properties Analysis of Umbilical for ADCP on Semi Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: With the development of platform digital technology, there are more and more applications of semi-submersible platform monitoring systems. Semi-submersible platforms use Acoustic Doppler Current Profiler (ADCP) to monitor local current parameters, umbilical transmit power and signal from the platform to the ADCP. This paper analyzes the performance and interference state of the umbilical used on the ADCP of Lingshui 17–2 platform during the in-service period. The results show that the mechanical properties of the umbilical which used on the ADCP are meet the requirements of the project.

articleTitle: Study on the Technology of Ultraviolet Laser Cleaning Ship Surface Paint Layer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: An Eco-friendly ultraviolet (UV) laser is employed in removing paint layer from the marine ship surface. A tailored photothermal and photochemical model based on ultraviolet laser cleaning ship surface paint layer has been innovatively presented. In this paper, we elaborate the photothermal and photochemical mechanisms are the main interacting mechanism during laser cleaning and acquire the UV laser cleaning conditions for attachment detachment. According to the UV laser interaction with materials, the physical process of UV laser cleaning has been analyzed in detail. To verify the correctness of the model, we carry out verification from three aspects: temperature, surface topography, and surface element content. It is witnessed that UV laser is the joint action of photothermal and photochemical to clean the paint layer on the ship surface. In a word, this study not only provides significant insights into the mechanism and theoretical model of UV laser cleaning ship surface paint but also provides a novel method for surface decontamination in the marine industry.

articleTitle: Prediction and Application of Unpowered Descent & Ascent of Deep-sea HOV
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Unpowered descent/ascent is the preferred way for deep-sea Human Occupied Vehicle (HOV) to descend and ascend. Unpowered descent/ascent can greatly save the energy of the HOV to improve the underwater operation time, which is one of the important foundations of underwater operation ability of the HOV. In this paper, “Jiao Long” HOV is taken as the research object. Based on the model of unpowered descent/ascent motion, the force of the HOV is analyzed and the prediction method of unpowered descent/ascent motion of the HOV is formed. The method is verified by using the data of “Jiao Long“ HOV’ s 7000m class sea test. The feasibility and effectiveness of the method are verified by comparing with the data from sea test, which can meet the requirements of engineering application. The unpowered descent/ascent motion prediction software of the HOV is developed based on MATLAB platform, which provides reliable technical means for accurate control of unpowered descent/ascent motion in practical application.

articleTitle: Simulated Sonar Image Generation Method Based on Improved CycleGAN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The stylization method based on CycleGAN network can easily synthesize simulated sonar images when the dataset is small. However, the CycleGAN network does not retain the structure of the real sonar image, resulting in a large gap between the structure and texture of the generated image and the real image. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an improved CycleGAN algorithm. By fusing Unet and Otsu segmentation algorithms, the segmentation effect of sonar image is improved. And by adding SSIM loss, the structural characteristics of the generated image are further limited. Through the evaluation of multiple indicators, it is proved that the algorithm in this paper has improved the image similarity compared with the original CycleGAN, and better retains the structural characteristics of the original image.

articleTitle: Unified-Affine-Projection-Like Subband-Adaptive Filtering Algorithm for Channel Estimation Under Impulsive Noise Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The unified-affine-projection-like subbands adaptive filter (UAPLSAF) algorithm is proposed, which makes use of the structure of a multiband adaptive filter and affine projection algorithm, and is robust against for reducing the affects on the outliuers consed by these unexpected impulsive-noises (INs). By changing the suitable parameters in the cost function, we can get different excellent affine projection (AP)-like algorithms. All of these algorithms have outstanding performance under INs. Besides, the created UAPLSAF presents better behaviors if we use convergence rate as an criterion and compare it with the former subband adaptive-filters like IMSAF and APSSAF with a worse noise environments like INs. Simulations have verified the effectiveness of the UAPLSAF algorithm.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Unmanned Ships Using Modified APF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Artificial potential field algorithm is a classical path planning algorithm which has been developed continuously in the past decades. Although it is suitable in virous kinds of situations, there are also some shortcomings which prevent it from further applications. This paper improves the algorithm for some special obstacle avoidance scenarios, such as the problem that the traditional APF method cannot be applied to when the threat area is an irregular polygon and so on. The improved APF algorithm is based on the traditional APF algorithm with a combination of new modelling ideas. To further verify the modified algorithm, MATLAB software is used for simulation under different situations. The new program can be applied in more complex obstacle avoidance scenarios.

articleTitle: An Numerical Simulation of Active Control Method of Underwater Propeller Low-frequency Radiated Noise
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: An active noise reduction method for low frequency linear spectrum radiated noise of propeller is proposed. By placing secondary sound source and hydrophone around propeller, active noise reduction is carried out according to acoustic interference principle and adaptive filtering algorithm. In this paper, the numerical calculation results of near-field and far-field radiated noise of propeller based on Suboff model are used to verify that the method can achieve the noise reduction effect of low-frequency line spectrum noise. Moreover, by comparing the placement positions of different secondary sound sources and hydrophones, the layout scheme of active control system is preliminarily proposed.

articleTitle: Multi-Sensor Fusion-Assisted AGV Localization System in GNSS Denied Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In order to address the issue of unmanned transport vehicle localization under the scenario of global satellite positioning system failure and meet the high stability and precision localization demands of factory unmanned vehicles, this paper conducts a comprehensive study from the overall design of the localization system to the specific implementation of the fusion localization algorithm involving global satellite positioning system, inertial navigation, and laser radar. Through the utilization of error state Kalman filtering, this study integrates the state estimates from the satellite inertial subsystem and laser radar inertial subsystem, achieving a seamless transition between different system fusion outcomes at the localization level of unmanned transport vehicles. Notably, in situations where satellite positioning is unavailable for up to 20 seconds, the proposed localization system maintains an accuracy within 5 cm, thereby fulfilling the localization requisites of unmanned transport vehicles within operational scenarios. This work holds significant significance for domains such as intelligent manufacturing and autonomous driving.

articleTitle: Affine-Projection Maximum Asymmetric Correntropy Criterion Algorithm Under System Identifications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The Affine-Projection Maximum Asymmetric Correntropy Criterion (APMACC) is constructed, drawing upon the fundamental principles of the maximum asymmetric correntropy criterion and an affine-projection scheme. The APMACC algorithm incorporates the asymmetric Gaussian model as a kernel function within the Affine-Projection (AP) algorithm framework, thereby endowing it with robustness against asymmetrically distributed noise. Furthermore, the bound for step-size is established in the literature. Simulation results demonstrate that the APMACC has fast convergence and low steady-state.

articleTitle: ADS Adaptive Backstepping Sliding Mode Depth Controller with Time-Varying Disturbance Observer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The Atmospheric Diving Suit (ADS) depth movement control have some problems caused by model uncertainty, unknown disturbance. To address these problems, this paper introduces a sliding mode backstepping and time-varying observer disturbance observer with adaptive law. The time-varying disturbance observer can track disturbance on ADS move, and the adaptive sliding mode backstepping controller controls the vertical movement of ADS, thus the tracking error can be controlled to approximately zero. In the paper, to test the controller's stability and proving the controller can track the error caused by model uncertainty and disturbance, the Lyapunov method is used. Simulation proves the controller's performance in overcoming uncertainties and disturbances with good robustness, stability and error-tracking convergence.

articleTitle: Study on Reflection Coefficient of the Medium with Continuously Varying Acoustic Impedance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: This paper considers a plane wave through the medium with changing acoustic impedance between two homogeneous media. The density and the sound speed both vary continuously through the medium. Several typical profiles of the intermediate layer are considered in this paper. Analytical solutions of Helmholtz equation in inhomogeneous media are derived for different density and sound speed distributions. The reflection coefficient dependent on frequency and on the structure of the medium are obtained. It is demonstrated that the results in this paper are more exact compared with traditional transfer matrix method. It is important to have study its acoustic characteristics for acoustic coating design and many fields else.

articleTitle: Passive Sonar Multi-Target Frequency Feature-Aided Data Association Algorithm Based On DPGMM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In passive sonar system, it's always a challenge to accomplish multi-target data association. We propose a remedy for this problem by using a frequency feature-aided data association algorithm to track targets' frequency and bearing information simultaneously. Frequency and bearing information are extracted by Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Model(DPGMM). Simulation results are presented to illustrate the tracking performance of the proposed algorithm in terms of incorrect association, association interrupt times and tracking accuracy aspect.

articleTitle: Research on the Equivalent Method of Complex Structures Based on a Few Simple Sources in Typical Shallow Sea Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The prediction of acoustic radiation from elastic structures in waveguides is a hot topic in the field of underwater acoustics. The equivalent source method, which equates the acoustic radiation of a structure to a series of virtual point sources, has become one of the mainstream methods for acoustic forecasting with the advantages of intuitive physical meaning and adaptability. However, due to the waveguide environment and the complexity of the elastic structure, the conventional method requires a large number of equivalent sources to match the acoustic quantities of the measurement surface, which limits the computational efficiency. In this paper, a complex structure equivalence method using a small number of simple sources is proposed. The method selects, one by one, the equivalence source with the best match between the radiated sound field and the measured sound pressure at far field among a large number of uniformly distributed equivalence sources, and discards the remaining equivalence sources with a high linear dependence to reduce the total number. Using a complex cylindrical shell in a typical shallow sea waveguide as an example, it is demonstrated that the proposed method can greatly reduce the number of equivalent sources while ensuring the accuracy of sound field prediction.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Inertial Navigation Information Fusion Method Based on Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The error propagation characteristics of two or more inertial navigation system (INS) devices are different with different accuracy levels. When the high precision inertial navigation system fails, how to make the low precision inertial navigation system work independently in the best state is an important research content of multi-inertial navigation systems. The Kalman filter is used to fuse the information of strapdown inertial navigation system and rotating inertial navigation system. The common fusion methods are position fusion, velocity fusion, “velocity + attitude” fusion, and “position + velocity” fusion. Position and velocity are the linear motion information of ship navigation, which are slow variables, and the amount of error caused by transmission delay is small. Attitude is the angular motion information of ship motion, which is a fast variable. The error caused by transmission delay is large, and the tracking effect of azimuth error is poor under the condition of ship maneuvering. In this paper, the principle of multi-inertial navigation system information fusion based on Kalman filter is studied, and the state equations and observation equations of position fusion and position + velocity fusion of multi-inertial navigation system are further established. The correctness of the fusion scheme is verified by the fusion simulation of strap down and single-axis rotating inertial navigation system, and strap down and biaxis rotating inertial navigation system.

articleTitle: Research on Power and Efficiency Optimization Technology of Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The application of wireless power transmission(WPT) is intended to make power supply more flexible and convenient, and to replace traditional plug-in contact charging in specific situations, such as the charging of underwater equipment. If the transmission power and efficiency of the WPT system cannot meet the requirements, it will not only lose its original design significance but also cause a waste of energy. Therefore, the power and efficacy optimization technology of the WPT system has always been a hot topic in research. The control strategy plays an important role in the performance optimization of the WPT system, and different control strategies such as circuit topology control and parameter optimization control have been widely used in WPT. This paper summarizes the latest and classic control methods, and analyzes their control models and principles. It is hoped that the research in this paper can provide new reference ideas for scholars engaged in WPT system research.

articleTitle: Experimental and Numerical Study on the Effect of Nozzle Number on Large-Bore Marine Engine Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The experimental and numerical research, based on a large-bore marine single-cylinder engine, on the influence of the number of nozzle holes on the engine performance was carried out. Two injectors, which have identical structural parameters except the nozzle hole number, were investigated in the experiment. The pressure difference between inlet and exhaust was altered for studying the effect of the number of injector holes on the performance and emission of the diesel engine under different conditions. The experimental results show that the fuel consumption, NOx emission, and SOOT emission of the 8-hole injector are lower than those of the 7-hole injector under the same pressure-difference boundary and same maximum combustion pressure, in which the fuel consumption is reduced by 2-7g/kWh, NOX emission and SOOT emission are reduced by 50-100ppm and 0.2-0.4FSN respectively. The CFD calculation was carried out to explain the experimental results. The simulation shows that the flow rate of the injector with 7 holes is smaller, and the center of combustion is far away from the top dead center, which results in increased fuel consumption. The single-hole fuel jet of the 7-hole injector has larger momentum because of the longer injection duration. After hitting the wall, the fuel jet develops along the wall and in the opposite direction of the injection, and the interference of the fuel jet itself and adjacent jets is strengthened, resulting in more high-temperature zones, and thus the increase of NOx. The strengthened interference of the fuel jet itself and adjacent jets results in high fuel concentration zones, which leads to higher SOOT formation rate and lower SOOT oxidation rate, so that SOOT emission is increased. The experimental and numerical research conducted in this paper can provide guidance for further energy conservation and emission reduction of large-bore marine diesel engines.

articleTitle: Rain Removal for Single Image based on DenseNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Under rainy conditions, computer vision systems will be disturbed by rain, resulting in degraded image quality. So, it is important to remove rain streaks from images and preserve image information meanwhile. For removing rain from a single image, the existing methods, whether based on prior knowledge or neural network, are either excessive or incomplete. In order to effectively remove rain streaks from a single image, the guided filtering is proposed for image pre-processing, the DenseNet is used as the basic network, and the dense blocks with different structures are used to build rain removal network. The experimental results show that, the proposed method can effectively extract the rain streaks residual mapping, remove the rain streaks in the rain image, and better preserve and restore the original background of the image.

articleTitle: Underwater Object Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv7-tiny
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Due to the complex and ever-changing underwater environment, underwater object detection is prone to issues such as missed detection, false detection, and low precision in precision measurement. This article proposes an improved YOLOv7-tiny underwater object detection model. Firstly, the convolutional block attention module (CBAM) module is introduced in the Neck section to improve the feature extraction ability for feature objects by adjusting the weight parameters between each channel during feature extraction; Secondly, soft Non-maximum suppression(Soft -NMS) algorithm is used to replace the Non-maximum suppression algorithm in the original network, and the detection accuracy of overlapping targets is improved by appropriately retaining overlapping detection boxes. Finally, the content-aware reassembly of features (CARAFE) is used to replace the nearest neighbor interpolation in the original model, fusing feature information from different scales to improve the model's expression ability. The experimental results show that the improved object detection model has improved the average accuracy by 3.72 %, 5.33%, and 1.7% compared to the original model, YOLOv5, and YOLOv8, respectively, achieving good detection results.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of the Propagation Characteristics of Electric Dipole Radiation Fields Across Media
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The widely use of electromagnetic waves to realize sea-ice-air across-media propagation information is important for the research in fields such as integrated sea-air-sky communication networks. This paper establishes the electromagnetic wave sea-ice-air across-media propagation model based on the CST Studio Suite 2019 simulation software, and uses the heterogeneous parallel numerical computing technology of Graphic Processing Unit (GPU) to perform the simulation calculation. A sea-ice-air model is established to compare with the sea-air model, and the propagation characteristics of the electric dipole radiation field across the medium at different frequencies and depths in the Very Low Frequency (VLF) band are studied. The results show that the electric dipole radiation field across the sea-ice-air medium is more attenuated than that across the sea-air medium, which more accurately simulates the electromagnetic wave transmission across the medium in the real marine environment.

articleTitle: An Improved EMD Algorithm based on Complete Complementary Adaptive Noise
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Conventional EMD has the problems of mode aliasing and endpoint effect, this paper introduced the principle and steps of conventional EMD, and introduced the principles of EEMD, CEEMD and various improved EMD. On the basis of the existing improved methods, combining the ideas of adaptive noise and complementary noise, an improved method Complete Complementary Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CCEEMDAN) was proposed. The performance of EMD and its improved method, including time domain decomposition results, reconstruction error and iteration times. Experimental results showed that the proposed method can solve the problems of modal aliasing and endpoint effect in EMD. At the same time, the proposed method has a smaller reconstruction error and fewer iterations, which is the closest to the reconstruction error and iteration times of EMD. The effectiveness and superiority of the improved method are proved.

articleTitle: An Efficient Fixed and Mobile Cooperative Backup Strategy Based on 5G Private Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: With the development of cloud computing and big data technology, data backup and recovery strategies become crucial to ensure the security and availability of enterprise and personal data. As a key technology for the fifth-generation (5G) network construction, the 5G private network aims to provide faster, more reliable wireless communications services. In this paper, we propose an efficient fixed and mobile cooperative backup strategy based on the 5G private network. The strategy uses the characteristics of high speed, low latency and high reliability of the 5G private network to connect fixed and mobile devices in the same backup network. The typical application scenarios and effect analysis show that the strategy can realize the collaborative operation of data backup and recovery, which has great potential and value in practical applications,

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Linear and Nonlinear Waves in the Numerical Wave Tank
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In order to study the hydrodynamic problems in the physical field of sea environment, a three-dimensional numerical wave tank is constructed based on computational fluid dynamics method. The generations of linear wave, second-order wave and freak wave are described and simulated by using the inlet boundary condition of the velocity distribution on the inlet boundaries, and the wave damping zone is used to eliminate waves in the end of tank. Based on the convergent study of linear and second order waves propagation, the freak wave has been generated in the tank finally and the result has been compared with the analytical solution. It indicates that the present study can be a useful refer for the research in hydrodynamic analysis of ocean structure operated in the sea.

articleTitle: Optical Covert Communication Based on Microwave Photonic Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Optical communication networks are easy to be eavesdropped by attackers, and traditional encryption algorithms have become more and more difficult to ensure the security of information transmission. Different from the traditional encryption algorithm, optical covert communication processes the signal at the physical layer, and improves the security and reliability of the system by hiding the optical signal in the public channel. Based on a typical microwave photonic filter, an optical covert communication scheme is proposed. On the one hand, the microwave photonic filter makes the scheme imperceptible. On the other hand, the randomness of complementary coding makes the scheme confidential. The feasibility of the scheme is analyzed theoretically, and the experimental results show that the covert channel is successfully transmitted over 50 km single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Power Conversion and Control of Wave Energy Generation System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The wave energy generation system is playing an important role in development and utilization marine energy resources, however it is hard to get high performance electrical power using traditional power conversion method due to the significant irregular characteristic of wave energy, which leads output voltage of wave power system to fluctuate heavily. A scheme is proposed in this paper by taking advantage of one-cycle-control (OCC) of active rectifier and the topology of isolated three port converter (TPC). Compared with the conventional solutions, this scheme not only is independent of phase-locked-loop of severe change of AC side voltage, but also the improved and stable rectified DC voltage can be obtained with port coordination control of TPC. Simulation results are presented to demonstrate the efficiency of the given method.

articleTitle: Target Recognition and Localization-based Manipulator Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The ocean is rich in resources., but the harsh marine environment poses a great danger to manual fishing operations. Underwater robots have great potential in the field of underwater operations and can be equipped with robotic arms for fishing applications, thus improving the efficiency of fishing operations as well as reducing the operational risks. In this paper, we study a robotic arm control system based on the target recognition and target localization. We use YOLO v3 algorithm to identify sea cucumbers and the AP is 94.78% on the sea cucumber image test set. We calculate the 3D coordinates of the sea cucumber by binocular camera and convert the position of the sea cucumber to the coordinate system of the robot arm, and then we can control the movement of the end of the robot arm to the location of the sea cucumber.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Ship Heave Motion and Ensemble Learning Prediction Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Prediction of ship heave motion is of great significance to wave compensation, and high-precision prediction is the most important prerequisite for wave compensation control. Therefore, a prediction analysis of ship heave motion and ensemble learning prediction strategy are proposed in this paper. First, Hurst index is calculated to analyze the predictability of time series. Secondly, the one-dimensional sequence is reconstructed into a multidimensional phase space. Finally, the number of Long Short-term memory models in phase space involved in ensemble learning is determined, and multiple phase space LSTM models with different weights are used for AdaBoost ensemble prediction to obtain multi-step heave motion prediction data. The experimental results show that the data with large Hurst index under the same sea state level are more predictable, and the multi-step prediction effect of LSTM and AdaBoost ensemble learning through phase space reconstruction is better than ARIMA, SVM, BP, and LSTM models, which can provide high-precision prediction for wave compensation of ship heave motion.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Evaluation of High Proportion of Clean Energy Access to Urban Power Grid Under Digitization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the high percentage of clean energy access and the level of electrical digitization, the urban power grid development will exhibit new features. To satisfy the requirements of the new forms of urban power grids development, a comprehensive evaluation index system with a high percentage of clean energy access to urban power grids is built from three parts: clean energy consumption, power supply reliability and customer satisfaction, and at the same time, the fuzzy analytic hierarchy method is used to evaluate the urban power grid comprehensively and judge the planning level of the urban power grid.

articleTitle: Statistical Energy Analysis-Based Sound Absorption Coefficient Calculation Model and Noise Reduction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Statistical energy analysis model for cabins was built based on the VA One platform. In addition, separate calculation was conducted on the structural vibration-caused and airborne noise of a power generator, and their contributions to the noise in different cabins were analyzed. Results show that structural vibration-caused sound was transmitted farther and contributed more to the noise in distant cabins. With the help of the principles of reverberation room, a statistical energy analysis model for calculating sound absorption coefficient and reverberation time was built. A sound absorbing material suitable for the major frequency range over which noise occurs can be chosen based on its sound absorption coefficient curve and the frequency features of cabin noise. By comparing schemes, we identified a sound absorption and isolation case that helps cabin noise and reverberation time meet requirements, providing reference for vibration and noise reduction in cabins.

articleTitle: An Acoustic Coating with Cylindrical Cavities Embedded in the Diagonal Direction of an Elastic Medium with Broadband Sound Absorption Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Acoustic structures with cavities are generally applied in underwater acoustic coatings. Previous studies on improving the sound absorption bandwidth of anechoic coatings with cavities have generally focused on increasing the number of cavity layers, resulting in a large total thickness. An acoustic model composed of cylindrical cavities distributed in the diagonal direction of a soft elastic medium is presented in this study to solve this puzzle. The distances between cavities are designed as negative gradient so as to obtain a broadband absorption bandwidth. Compared with the acoustic model with cavities distributed in the incident direction, the proposed model with cavities in the diagonal direction possess a wider absorption range with a lower total thickness. Investigations under different geometrical parameters such as lattice constant are performed to study the influences of the parameters on the sound absorption of the proposed model. The findings confirm that the sound absorption bandwidth can be broadened effectively by arranging cavities in this particular way with the total thickness significantly decreased.

Author Keywords: Cylindrical Cavities In The Diagonal Direction

articleTitle: Design and Finite Element Verification of Underwater Magnetic Coupler with High Fault Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Wireless power transfer technology can improve the flexibility and concealment of Autonomous Underwater Vehicle. However, due to the complex operation environments, such as microbial attachment and ocean current, the magnetic couplers become much more difficult to be docked. As a result, more stringent requirements have been put forward for underwater wireless power transfer. In this paper, a novel magnetic coupler design strategy with enhanced fault tolerance has been proposed and verified by finite element modeling technology. The results show that the anti-offset capability can be improved by 26.52% while the temperature rise can be 18% lower than the traditional design strategy. The experiments fit well with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on High Precision Coordinate Measurement Method Based on Maximum Likelihood Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The rapid development of advanced manufacturing industry in China has put forward higher requirements for equipment technology level. For ship construction industry, high-precision three-dimensional coordinate measurement directly determines the level of ship equipment. Since the ship construction environment is very poor, traditional measuring method can not realize a high precision, and high efficiency coordinate measurement. In order to solve this problem, combining with the characteristics of the construction environment, this paper proposes a high accuracy coordinate measurement method based on maximum likelihood estimation, and a ship high precision navigation and positioning system has been invented. The simulationresults show that the proposed algorithm has better environment adaptability and robustness compared with the traditional positioning method. The position precision can reach under 1 mm, realizing the high precision coordinate measurement in harsh conditions

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Variable Geometry Turbocharging System of Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In this paper, GT-POWER software is used to establish and verify the diesel engine simulation model of a variable geometry turbocharging system for a marine diesel engine matching a variable geometry turbocharger. The influence law of performance parameters such as turbine outlet temperature, boosting ratio, fuel consumption and maximum combustion pressure with different turbine nozzle ring opening degrees were studied. The results show that with the decrease of turbine nozzle ring opening degree, the low working condition performance of diesel engine can be effectively improved, and the low fuel consumption area of diesel engine can be expanded, the matching strategy of the turbine nozzle ring opening degree under the propulsion characteristics of the diesel engine with the variable geometry turbocharging system is obtained, so as to reduce the running cost of the diesel engine.

articleTitle: UPITs: Underwater Monitoring System for Cooperative AUVs Using Acousitc Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Displaying the operation information of AUVs in real-time is an important subject of Smart Ocean. The design of monitoring systems is often limited by application scenarios and technological developments. This paper develops an underwater monitoring system based on an underwater acoustic sensor network for the cooperative AUV. The system comprehensively considers the information transmission characteristics of underwater, air, and land and uses the underwater acoustic long baseline positioning technology to design a reasonable system architecture and workflow. Through experiments, we have verified that the system has high positioning accuracy and a convenient display process. The system can effectively support the acquisition of marine information so people can speed up the pace of understanding the ocean.

articleTitle: Application of Variable Step Feedback Adaptive Active Control Algorithm in Underwater Noise Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The low-frequency radiated sound field can be effectively controlled through the adaptive active control method in theory. However, its application in underwater radiated noise control is not wide. In the active control system, especially the multi-channel feedback system, the step size has a very tremendous influence on the performance of the adaptive filter. If the step size is set unreasonably, the calculation results will not converge. The appropriate step size varies from case to case. For simple cases, the empirical value can be adopted to set the step size. When the numerical difference between channels is large, and when the control physical quantity such as sound pressure changes greatly with time, an determined step length can't meet the control requirements. In particular, it is difficult to choose the step size when the accurate reference signal cannot be obtained. The application of adaptive active methods in underwater noise control is limited to some extent by this problem. To solve this problem, this essay carried out the research of Filtered-X Least Mean Squares (FxLMS) algorithm based on variable step size, and carried out the corresponding numerical analysis and pool experiment to verify the feasibility of applying to underwater noise control.

articleTitle: Underwater Electric Field Communication System Based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: This paper proposes a design scheme of underwater electric field communication system based on ZigBee technology, and focuses on the overall structure and the design of each component of the system. Based on the traditional underwater electric field communication, the system introduces ZigBee technology to realize the underwater communication network. Each ZigBee module is connected to a Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP) for data interaction. The system has the characteristics of low cost, low power consumption, flexible configuration and wide coverage.

articleTitle: Applications of Digital Twin Technology in AUV
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Digital twin is driven by multi-dimensional virtual model and fused data, through virtual and real closed loop interaction, to achieve monitoring, simulation, prediction, optimization and other practical functional services and application requirements. At present, there are three problems in digital twin, and the concept of digital twin is controversial. Digital twin lacks a practical model-device data communication method. There are few applications of digital twin, especially in the field of AUV. Based on the above three problems, this paper first summarizes the concept and applications of digital twin. Then, an center server data transfer framework is proposed for model to device data communication. Finally, the application method of digital twin in AUV is discussed.

articleTitle: Multi-Channel Adaptive Control of Underwater Structure Radiated Sound Field Based on Bilateral Secondary Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Low-frequency noise generated by underwater vehicles during navigation can destroy the ocean environment. The active control method is based on the principle of the interference cancellation of sound waves to cancel the low-frequency noise. This study proposes the multi-channel adaptive control method for sound pressure signals to counteract the low-frequency noise radiated by the underwater cylindrical shell. The result of simulation and experiment verify that the adaptive control system designed in this research can effectively reduce the low-frequency radiated noise of the underwater cylindrical shell.

articleTitle: Optimizational Algorithms for Source Parameters with Single Hydrophone in Shallow Water
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Though analyzing the characteristics of normal modes in complex marine environments, this paper proposes a modal selection method in source motion parameters estimating technique based on broadband interference structures with single hydrophone. By extracting the normal modes that play a significant role in the interference structure, the suitability of motion parameter estimation algorithm in complex marine environments is greatly improved. In numerical simulations, the excellent applicability of the optimization algorithm in shallow sea waveguides with negative sound speed gradient profile and elastic seabed condition is verified. Finally, the applicability of the optimized algorithm in complex marine environments is verified by experimental data from sea areas with elastic seabed. The estimated values of radial velocity and initial distance are in good agreement with the actual parameters of the ship.

articleTitle: Research on Sea Surface Target Detection Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The ocean plays an increasingly prominent role in safeguarding national sovereignty, security, and development interests. The breakthrough and application of key technologies such as unmanned surface vessel intelligence is an important technical support for understanding the ocean, utilizing the ocean, and managing the ocean. The detection of sea surface objects based on visual images is an important way to realize the intelligent environment perception of unmanned surface vessels. Aiming at the difficulties in feature extraction and low detection accuracy of traditional sea surface target detection algorithms, this paper proposes an unmanned surface vessel sea surface target detection algorithm based on deep learning. We propose Cross-layer weighted Path Aggregation Network, by introducing two bottom-up paths for weighted feature fusion, to obtain feature interaction across dimensions and spaces, and propose Double residual group convolution to apply to backbone network and Cross-layer weighted Path Aggregation Between networks, the feature layer fuses rich semantic information and fine-grained information. The ECA attention mechanism is introduced to bring large performance gains at the cost of fewer parameters. Experiments show that the AP of our model can reach 74.9<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and when deployed on an unmanned surface vessel, it can detect occluded targets and long-distance small targets in real time under complex sea conditions. It has great potential in improving the marine survey capability of unmanned surface vessel and collecting marine data.

articleTitle: Study on the Agile Emergency Networking System in Deep and Remote Sea
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Unmanned underwater vehicles (UUV) play an important role in deep and remote sea exploration, but the inability of data return in real time restricts their mass use. An agile emergency network system for deep and remote sea (AENSiDRS) is proposed to solve the above problem by using technologies related to float, landers, autonomous & remotely operated vehicles (ARV) and distributed acoustic sensing (DAS).
