The AENSiDRS has the advantages of cross-domain real-time communication, low-cost, medium to long-term endurance, and underwater sensing, which providing a new solution for real-time data return of UUVs. In this paper, system design, working principle and key technologies of the AENSiDRS is described. Some equipment has been test in sea trials verifying the feasibility of the AENSiDRS.

articleTitle: Explainable Recommendation for Hazard Inspection Reasoning Through Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In the process of hazards inspecting in safety production, the number and types of hazard entities are often vast and varied. Introducing of existing recommendation algorithms may lead to low recommendation quality and lack of explain ability. To address these challenges, achieving dual improvement in accuracy and reliability of hazard inspection recommendations. We propose three metrics that represent the explanation quality of recommendation results: Inspection Recency of Hazard, Risk Level of Entity and Utilization Rate of Graph. And then we propose two optimization methods on model inner-training and post-training: Pruning-Strategy Optimization and Re-Rank Optimization. In hazards inspection dataset of safety production, hazard inspection recommendation NDCG@10 reaches 0.433(5.1 % higher than baseline) and overall path explanation metric scores reaches 1.928(74.8% higher than baseline). Compared with previous algorithms, our methods achieve higher recommendation performance and explainability quality.

articleTitle: Research on Data Asset Value Evaluation Model Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The management of data assets helps to improve the level of data application in electric power enterprises and accelerate the transformation of enterprises to intelligence and digitalization. The paper constructs a data asset evaluation model, in which the evaluated elements include two elements of data quality value and data asset application value, and then introduces a hierarchical analysis method to construct an index evaluation system and conduct an arithmetic analysis. The research results show that the data asset value assessment model constructed in the thesis can well reflect the value of data assets and is an important supplement to the study of data asset application.

articleTitle: Review of Heave Compensation Systems: Design and Control Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Heave compensator has significant application value in the field of offshore engineering, involving offshore lifting operation, floating wind power installation, etc. In this paper, the basic characteristics of heave compensation, including passive heave compensation (PHC), active heave compensation (AHC), and active/passive heave compensation (APHC), are reviewed, with an emphasis on recent years. The performance differences of the various systems are compared and analyzed, and in the final section, potential future development opportunities are proposed.

articleTitle: Terminal Sliding Mode Fault Tolerant Control for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: This paper investigates a fault tolerant control (FTC) scheme based on terminal sliding mode technology for autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) in the presence of modelling uncertainty, ocean current disturbance and unknown thruster faults. Firstly, a thruster fault diagnosis method is proposed, which includes two modules of fault detection and fault estimation. Observers are used both in the two modules, and for accurate thruster fault reconstruction, the fault identification scheme is proposed to estimate the thruster fault effect by introducing an intermediate variable. Then, a fault tolerant controller is proposed based on terminal sliding mode control technique, which guarantees that the trajectory tracking errors of AUV is asymptotically stable subject to thruster fault. Finally, results from simulations are presented to verify the effectiveness of the proposed active fault tolerant control method for different kinds of desired trajectories and multiple types of thruster faults.

articleTitle: Underwater Target Detection Based on Improved Yolov5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Remotely Operated Vehicle (ROV) has been widely used for underwater rescue, underwater detection, underwater fishing and other underwater missions. Underwater target detection can obtain the class information and position information of the target. The vision-based underwater target detection algorithm can enhance the underwater observation capability of ROV, which is crucial for ROV to achieve high precision underwater grasping and underwater fishing. Based on this, this paper improves the original network architecture of YOLO v5 to make it better adapted to the requirements of underwater target detection tasks, including: replacing the SPPF layer in the original backbone network using the MSPPF structure; introducing a new loss function Alpha-SIOU. These operations can better detect the small and dense characteristics of underwater targets and enable the detector to capture features more accurately. In this paper, experiments are conducted based on underwater biological datasets. The results show the improved Y olov5 achieves an average accuracy of 78.1%, which is a significant improvement over the baseline of YOLO v5.

publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Turbulence near sea surface will cause the irregular flow of the whole atmosphere, lead to the distortion of the ship-based lidar echo, and destroy the stability of the system. Kolmogorov turbulence spectrum was used to analyze 1.55μm laser. The nonlinear optical effect of 1.55um laser in turbulent atmosphere is mainly analyzed, and its influence on the heterodyne efficiency, range resolution, carrier noise ratio and wind speed estimation accuracy of lidar system is analyzed. Finally, the simulation shows that the small aperture transmission is considered in the transceiver, and the adaptive adjustment device for large aperture reception can effectively reduce the impact of turbulence.

articleTitle: Optimization of Sound Absorption Properties and Acoustic Impedance of Multilayer Rubber
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Firstly, a model for calculating the sound absorption property of multilayer rubber is established by transfer matrix, and experimental samples are prepared to verify the accuracy of the model. Secondly, the effects of dynamic mechanical properties and thickness distribution of multilayer rubber on sound absorption properties were studied based on the dynamic mechanical properties of Styrene Butadiene Rubber (SBR). Lastly, the material and structural parameters were optimized by a genetic algorithm. The results show that for multilayer composite structure rubber, the impedance gradient structure with decreasing acoustic impedance is better than the traditional structure with increasing acoustic impedance. In addition, a “sandwich modulus structure” with high storage modulus in the middle layer and low on both sides was also found. Through the impedance mismatch design between the layers, the energy loss of the acoustic wave in the material was greatly improved, and the sound absorption properties was better than the impedance gradient structure. The average sound absorption coefficient of the “sandwich modulus” structure is 39.6% higher than that of the uniform structure rubber.

articleTitle: Multi-Authority Attribute-Based Searchable Encryption in Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Ciphertext policy attribute-based encryption (CP-ABE) has been widely used as a fine-grained access control mechanism for data sharing. Existing research on CP-ABE schemes in cloud computing environment predominantly focuses on a single attribute authority, which may lead to high computation overhead or a single point of failure. Besides, the encrypted data stored in the cloud restricts ciphertext retrieval. Therefore, we propose a multi-authority attribute-based searchable encryption scheme in cloud storage called MASEP for sharing data securely. In addition, the MASEP scheme supports the validity of retrieving user attributes before decryption, reducing the unnecessary computation cost. Finally, the experiment results show that MASEP scheme is proved to be IND-CPA secure under the chosen plaintext attack, and it is more efficient and promising.

articleTitle: BiBE: A Self-supervised Contrastive Learning Architecture for Malware Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Malware detection has become significantly more difficult due to the constant evolution of malware and the emergence of various variants. While machine learning-based malware detection method solves the limitations of traditional methods to a certain extent, the vast majority of current work uses supervised learning methods, which require large sets of labeled data, which means a huge amount of manpower and time cost. Self-supervised learning can solve these problems by extracting information from unlabeled data for learning. In this paper, we introduce BiBE, a malware detection architecture based on self-supervised learning framework. We first preprocess the samples with normalization, complete the missing information of features, and perform vectorization processing. Then, after learning and encoding the sample features by setting proxy tasks, we use comparative learning to distinguish similar samples, achieve the division of positive and negative samples and assign pseudo-labels. Finally, the labeled samples and pseudo-labeled samples are put into the Bi-LSTM network to train the classifier to detect malware. Moreover, we also evaluate the model on a public dataset. The evaluation shows that the BiBE model has good convergence and generalization in training, achieves excellent detection performance, and outperforms other existing methods, verifying the feasibility of the BiBE model.

articleTitle: Multitone Jamming Rejection Performance of Dynamic Spectrum Anti-Jamming Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The influence of multitone jamming on the performance of a new dynamic spectrum anti-jamming (DSAJ) system is considered in this paper. Bit error rate (BER) of the system is analyzed over a two-level noise channel with multitone jamming. In order to obtain better anti-jamming performance, a new jamming cancellation method based on the expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm is proposed. Numerical and simulation results show that the performance of DSAJ systems is superior to the performance of conventional frequency hopping (FH) systems by communicating in spectrum holes with low jamming power. At medium to high signal-to-jamming ratio (SJR), another 2-4dB performance improvement is achieved via jamming cancellation and diversity transmission.

articleTitle: Automatic Voltage Regulator (AVR) Model of Power Management System Function Using Artificial Neural Network (ANN)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Based on the application of the ship power management system, the purpose of this work is to provide a method for operating an autonomous voltage regulator. To maintain the steady state of the system, this research focuses on the issue of active and reactive power regulation, and it presents simplified models of key components employed in the control system. Maintaining voltage and frequency within specified limits is a primary goal of this control technique, along with ensuring the most cost-effective and reliable power generation and distribution. In this paper, we present the design and implementation of an integral controller-tested method for Automatic Voltage Regulator Control alongside an Artificial Intelligence Technique-based. Simulation findings indicate that the suggested Neural Network Controller provides superior performance in comparison to the standard PID controller.

articleTitle: Calibration Method for Phase Consistency of Hydrophone Array Based on PSO-SA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In the process of hydrophone array fabrication, there is some phase deviation inevitably between the receiving elements, due to the difference in manufacturing process and hardware, which is called phase inconsistency. The phase inconsistency can cause serious interference to the property of the array signal processing. Therefore, in order to improve the performance of array system, it is particularly important to study the phase consistency calibration algorithm after array formation. In this paper, the particle swarm optimization based on the simulated annealing (PSO-SA) is applied to the phase consistency calibration, and the corresponding phase consistency intelligent matching search algorithm is formed. This calibration method is applicable to any linear or planar array needed to measure additional phase-shifting value between elements. Also, the simulation results of a linear array has been given. It is shown that the matching algorithm can accurately search the phase error between the array elements. And the actual calibration test of an irregular shape array is carried out, the measurement data of radiation sound pressure has been processed and analyzed to verify the performance improvement of the phase compensation for beam-forming.

articleTitle: Automatic Measurement of Contact Stress and Connection Force of Interference Components by Ultrasound
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Tiny interference components are crucial in the precision of Marine machinery. Contact stress and connection force are important factors to evaluate the quality of interference components. In this article, the ultrasonic method is used to measure the stress distribution and the connection force on the mating surface of interference components. The acoustic model is optimized to some extent by analyzing statistical micro-contact theory and virtual thin layer theory. On the basis of the above, we can get the reflection coefficient-contact stiffness mapping relationship. The contact stiffness contact stress mapping relationship is obtained with the help of calibration experiments. Then the stress distribution on the mating surface of interference components with two different structures, namely the uniform cylinder and the step cylinder, is measured and compared with the theoretical results of the thick-walled cylinder theory. The experimental results are in good agreement with the theoretical results. Finally, based on the measurement results of stress distribution, the connection force is calculated and compared with the connection force measured by the press-out experiment. The results show that the ultrasonic stress measurement method can accurately measure the connection force of interference components, and the relative error is within 20%. Therefore, this article can provide a better method for the quality analysis of interference components.

articleTitle: Constant Beam Width Beamforming Method for Vector Combination Vertical Array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: To address the problem of constant beam width beamforming required for water target radiation noise measurements, a constant beamwidth beamforming method based on a vector combined array is designed. The method uses the correlation of each channel of a single vector sensor to design a vector sound intensity filter, which improves the signal-to-noise ratio of the combined array sound pressure channel data as well as the array spatial gain. The vertical array measurement system is then extended to build a vector combined vertical array to achieve constant beamwidth beamforming, achieving the directivity of a full vector vertical array while also obtaining a certain time processing gain. Simulation experiments verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Dual-Excitation Nine-Electrode Conductivity Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of polarization effect and electrode corrosion in electrode conductivity sensor, a dual-excitation type nine-electrode conductivity sensor is optimized and designed by analyzing the equivalent measurement physical model of electrode conductivity sensor, establishing a theoretical calculation model of conductivity and output voltage, and supplemented by finite element analysis. The structure of the nine-electrode conductivity sensor was designed, and the corresponding calibration and test tests were carried out. The test results show that the nine-electrode conductivity sensor has excellent performance in eliminating polarization effect and reducing proximity effect, and the accuracy can reach ±0.001ms/cm. The measuring range is wide, and the measurement range is between 20mS/cm∼60mS/cm, which verifies the rationality of the structure. This structure can effectively improve the measurement accuracy and expand the measurement range, providing a new solution for researchers to measure the conductivity of seawater with high precision.

articleTitle: Gated Recurrent Unit Neural Network and Decision Tree for Offshore Nuclear Power Plant'S Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The external environment of the Offshore Nuclear Power Platform (ONPP) is complex, and the radioactive risk of the nuclear reactor device with internal feedback and strong coupling is high in the complex environment. In order to satisfy the safety and real-time performance of the nuclear reactor, this paper proposes a diagnosis method based on gated recurrent unit (GRU) neural network, the method makes full use of the time-varying and transient characteristics of the data generated during the operation of the nuclear reactor and makes joint diagnosis by decision tree and GRU network. The experimental results show that, compared with other models, this model can judge each fault more quickly and accurately, and the accuracy of fault diagnosis can reach more than 99.9%.

articleTitle: Research on Formation Switching and Reconfiguration Control Method of Unmanned Surface Vehicle Formation Escort Task
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The escort task is of great significance for the safe navigation of merchant ships. Compared with the conventional fleet, the use of unmanned surface vehicle formation to perform escort tasks can greatly save the escort cost and reduce casualties. This paper takes the formation of unmanned surface vehicle formation for escort task as the research object. Aiming at the problem that the formation needs to switch and restructure frequently according to different situations in the task, Null Space Based method is used to introduce event trigger mechanism, and the control strategies of formation switch and reconfiguration are designed respectively, which solves the problems of premature time, slow speed, lengthy process of formation switch and reconfiguration, and better completes the escort task. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the flexibility and robustness of unmanned surface vehicle escort formation.

articleTitle: DWA-based Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance Planning Method for USVs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: To solve the problem of environment perceived instability in the process of autonomous navigation of USVs, a local planning method based on DYNAMIC WINDOWS APPROACH is proposed for the known static obstacles and unknown dynamic obstacles collision avoidance planning in the navigation area of USVs, and combined with the Velocity Obstacle method, the velocity obstacle region is incorporated in the dynamic window to further optimize the speed constrained It also sets the fusion to start distance and limit distance in the evaluation function to take into account the safety and economy of the planning and improves the efficiency of the dynamic window method to evaluate the predicted trajectory for finding the best. The simulation results verify that the improved DWA can achieve automatic obstacle avoidance in complex environments, and ensure the safety of obstacle avoidance navigation while the planning path is more reasonable and smooth, avoiding the USVs from bypassing outside the dense obstacle cluster, and the number of iterations and running time are reduced by more than 15%. The research results have more obvious scientific value and practical significance to the development of autonomous obstacle avoidance technology for unmanned vehicles.

articleTitle: A 5G Access Admission Control Architecture Based on Service Offloading Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The rapid development of 5G communication technology has stimulated the innovation potential in the Internet of things, smart cities and industrial automation. Driven by China's digital strategy, 5G private network is crucial for digital construction. However, network security and information security become important issues in the process of enterprise digital construction. 5G access admission control architecture based on service offloading technology dynamically allocates network resources to service slices to meet the performance and quality of service requirements for different services and application requirements. This architecture can improve network resource utilization and support applications such as high-speed communication, Internet of things (IoT) and industrial automation. In this paper, we deeply discuss the 5G access admission control system based on traffic offloading technology, and focus on its key technologies, system architecture and security. One of the research innovations is 5G native Radius secondary authentication, which provides higher security. Another innovation lies in the controllability and manageability of customers' private network traffic, which enables operators to open traffic management to customers and realize self-service. The study aims to provide valuable insights for the development and optimization of 5G networks and provide guidance for future research and practice.

articleTitle: Study on Marine Propeller Design Using Artificial Neural Networks and Multivariate Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The designers of marine propellers usually encounter the problems of characteristics studies of propellers. These characteristics would include the relationships among design variables and performances, matching between propeller and ship hull, and choosing a compromise design solution from many alternatives. In this work, the study of these characteristics is presented based on artificial neural networks and multivariate analysis. First, the propeller design solutions are generated from design of experiment (DOE) approach using B-series charts for a given effective power-speed curve of ship, while taking geometry, cavitation constraints into consideration. The geometrical parameters and performance of propellers are included in one high-dimensional dataset. Then, the characteristics of this dataset are investigated by a famous artificial neural network, Self-Organizing Maps (SOM) and several multivariate methods. The relationships among design variable and performance are studied by correlation analysis and SOM graphs. The effects of geometrical parameters upon open water efficiency are found by main effect analysis. The clustering of solutions on SOM graphs are obtained through partitive clustering approach according to DB index. The significance of variables in these clusters is also studied. A parallel coordinate plot with cluster information also provides decision help to designers. The relationships among design variables are examined by hierarchical clustering then. In order to find the intrinsic structure of this high-dimensional dataset, a well-known dimensionality reduction skill, Isomap is utilized. The relationships among these variables are shown in 2D plots. Finally, a TOPSIS (Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution) procedure and entropy weight method are employed for finding final compromise solution from this dataset. A numerical example is provided in this work to illustrate the analysis process. The results show that the SOM and multivariate approaches are effective and they can mine useful information from dataset for propeller designers.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Control Method for Ship Path Tracking Accounting for Ship-Ship Hydrodynamic Interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Due to the advances of shipbuilding technology, ships are gradually developing in the direction of large-scale and intellectualization. However, the hydrodynamic interaction has been pronounced as the increase in dimensions of ships and has become a significant influencing factor of ships sailing in restricted waters, and the accuracy of ship motion control is limited due to the complex environmental disturbances. Based on the potential flow theory the Hess & Smith panel method, the ship hydrodynamic interaction is calculated in real time, and based on the MMG equation, an adaptive path tracking control method is devised that can be integrated with motions of equation of ships moving in restricted waters. Through frequency domain transformation, the ship response model in restricted waters is simplified to a ship dynamic model, and the model missing terms in the simplified process is adaptively estimated. Accounting for the computational efficiency of hydrodynamic interaction, a path tracking controller for ships in restricted waters is designed based on PD control method with appropriate parameters. By comparing the control effect of PD controller in the model without adaptive estimation and adaptive estimation model, the effectiveness of adaptive estimation is verified.

articleTitle: A Low-Latency Terminal Mutual Access Architecture Based on 5G LAN Cross-Domain Networking
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Compared with traditional Wi-Fi technology, the local area network (LAN) with the fifth generation mobile communication technology (5G) has higher speed and more reliable connections. It can support more devices to connect at the same time, and provide better network performance and user experience. This paper studies a low-latency terminal mutual access architecture based on 5G LAN cross-domain networking technology, aiming to cope with the growing demand for mobile communications and the urgent need for low-latency communications. We propose an innovative 5G LAN cross-domain networking solution that integrates the high bandwidth and low latency characteristics of 5G technology to achieve efficient mutual access between terminal devices. The architecture uses an advanced network topology to fully utilize resources between multiple 5G LAN domains, thereby providing excellent communication performance. The low-latency cross-domain communication architecture based on 5G LAN technology can significantly reduce the delay of mutual access between terminals, improve network throughput, and reduce the risk of network congestion. The low-latency terminal mutual access architecture based on 5G LAN cross-domain networking technology proposed in this paper has brought important innovations and improvements to the field of mobile communications. It is expected to promote the development of future mobile communication networks and meet the needs of users for high-quality and low-latency communication.

articleTitle: Measurement and Prediction Scheme for Ship Heave Motion Based on UKF and PSR-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The floating cranes used to install large wind turbines are at risk of instability and collision because of the dynamic and changing sea conditions. Ship-motion measurement and prediction of heave is applied for wave compensation, but a high prediction accuracy is difficult because of measurement drift and phase advance. To address this issue, a ship heave motion measurement and prediction scheme based on unscented Kalman filter, phase space reconstruction and long short-term memory (LSTM) is proposed. First, the Stewart platform is used to simulate ship motions, and data are collected by inertial sensors and are processed by unscented Kalman filter. Second, the mutual information is applied to calculate the delay of the ship-motion time series, and the Cao method is used to obtain the embedding dimension, then phase space reconstruction is carried out. Third, the reconstructed data are trained by the multidimensional LSTM to predict extremely short-term ship motions. Simulation results showed that the proposed method provides better measurement and better prediction accuracy, especially under more complex sea conditions.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Robust Second-Order Cone Model for the Dispatch of Multi-Microgrid Integrated Harbour Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The inherent fluctuation and randomness of massive distributed renewable power generation (RPG), such as the photovoltaic (PV), poses great challenge to the operation security of harbour distribution systems (HDSs). In this paper, a novel two-stage robust second-order cone programming (SOCP) model for the active and reactive collaborative dispatch of multi-microgrid integrated HDSs is proposed, which can effectively cope with the fluctuation and uncertainty of the RPG by utilizing flexible distributed resources in microgrids. In the first stage, the day-ahead long-time-scale scheduling variables are determined, and the intraday short-time-scale scheduling variables are further optimized in the second stage after the uncertainty of RPG and load is realized. Subsequently, the proposed two-stage robust SOCP model is solved with the SOCP based column and constraint generation algorithm (SOCP-CCG). Lastly, the simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively deal with the fluctuation and uncertainty of the RPG and load, while ensuring the voltage security and economic benefits of the power grid.
